status_summary: Executive Order 14213, signed 2025-02-14, established the National Energy Dominance Council in the Executive Office of the President, with the Secretary of Energy as Vice Chair, and directed it to provide the President a recommended National Energy Dominance Strategy, without a set deadline. No published energy dominance or energy security strategy, and no DOE Office of Policy energy security strategy, was found. The directed strategy is a White House council product on energy dominance rather than the DOE-prepared energy security strategy the Mandate describes.

timeline.event: Executive Order 14213 was signed, establishing the National Energy Dominance Council with the Secretary of Energy as Vice Chair and directing it to provide a recommended National Energy Dominance Strategy.

title: Develop a National Energy Security Strategy through DOE's Office of Policy
uncertainties: The White House fact sheet appeared in search results but was not opened. Absence of a published strategy rests on the researcher's two searches and one reviewer web search for a released National Energy Dominance Strategy, which returned only coverage of the council's creation. Executive Orders 14154 and 14156 were not read for strategy directions, and the December 2025 National Security Strategy, FY2027 budget language and DOE Office of Policy outputs were not checked.
